company.name: Loop
company.shortDescription: Loop provides a platform that manages logistics and supply chain data through automation and analytics tools.
company.description: Loop provides a platform that manages logistics and supply chain data through automation and analytics tools. The system aggregates shipment, carrier, and financial data into a unified interface to support visibility and coordination. It includes features for freight audit, payment processing, and cost tracking across transportation activities. The platform also supports issue resolution, reporting, and performance monitoring for carriers and shipments. Loop serves organizations that require structured data handling and process automation within logistics operations.

productsAndServices.description: A logistics data platform that unifies shipment, carrier, contract, invoice, and tracking data to automate transportation operations and support analytics across freight and parcel networks.

productsAndServices.description: Analytics and advisory services for evaluating parcel carrier contracts, discounts, rates, service levels, and network choices to reduce transportation spend.

productsAndServices.description: Logistics analytics and decision-support capabilities that provide financial, carrier, and network insights through dashboards, custom reports, alerts, and natural-language analysis.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $95,000,000, or 59.38% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $27,144,361 to $686,132,791, a 25.28x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 86 (-10 over 90 days) and market heat at 75 (-14).
